verdict.rationale: AgentMail has no built-in Q&A assistant. Its closest first-party piece is a hosted MCP server that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment and calendar tools to any compatible assistant. That is backed by full-text thread search across sender, recipients, subject and body, plus thread retrieval across the whole organization. Partial credit is generous, because the grounded question-answering itself comes from the external assistant, and the LangChain vector-store path is only a developer building block. Missing for 10: a native assistant that answers questions across the inbox and calendar, documented grounding or citation of answers, any 'what's outstanding' or commitment tracking, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
